inShort: B drops cross-court from the kitchen line and steps back after each ball until reaching the baseline. A collects the balls.
rules: Put 2–3 markers (shoes, bottles) in the middle of the kitchen, cross-court from B. A stands there.
B starts just behind the kitchen line, drops a ball, lets it bounce, and drops it to the markers.
Hit it out in front and finish high, with a light grip.
After each drop, B takes one step back, until B stands behind the baseline.
A lets the balls land, collects them and rolls them back. Once B is behind the baseline, swap roles.
tooEasy: From the baseline, A hand-feeds the ball to B, then feeds with the paddle. Even harder: one marker instead of an area.
tooHard: Stay at each distance for 3 drops. Aim high over the net first, then bring the height down.
goodLooksLike: The drops float over the net and land near the markers, and B finishes with the paddle high.
